fichas.title: Loading ramps and bridges
fichas.summary: Loading bridges connect loading ramps or yards to trucks and trailers at differing floor heights. The page illustrates flexible, mobile, slewing, and automatic hydraulic bridges, plus height-adjustment wedges and simple ramps.
uses: Bridge level differences between yard or ramp and vehicle
Load and unload trucks, trailers, and railway wagons

fichas.title: Hydraulic scissor-lift loading platforms
fichas.summary: Hydraulic scissor lifts bridge level differences between yard and vehicle or yard and ramp, and allow loading platforms to adapt to truck level. The diagrams show a platform for overcoming a ramp-to-yard difference and an HGV being loaded using a scissor lift.
uses: Raise or lower a loading platform to bridge level differences
Load and unload vehicles at different heights

fichas.title: Loading-bay weather protection and gates

uses: Waterproof the vehicle-to-building interface during loading
